rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the conclusion is obvious or evident.

example.english: Clearly, he isn't feeling well today.
example.jyutping: hou2 ming4 hin2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when something is immediately apparent from looking at or observing it.

example.english: You can clearly tell he is tired just by looking at him.
example.jyutping: jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 keoi5 hou2 gui6

rows.note: Use this manner construction when an action is performed in a clear, easy-to-understand way.

example.english: I explained it very clearly, and you still don't understand?
example.traditional: 我已經講得好清楚㗎喇，你仲唔明？
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 gaa3 laa3 nei5 zung6 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when clearly means that the speaker is certain rather than pointing to visible evidence.

example.english: They clearly won't lie to you.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 aak1 nei5
